rule: A page script may name a forbidden address (a weather or hazard value of a point computed outside the point state, or the provider itself) only when it is listed here with its reason. Every listed script is either operator-only, not a point value (transport, documentation, land-surface or air-quality inputs, place look-up), or a reviewed exception that cannot be rewired before 6 Nov without a large rewrite. A new script, or a new kind of forbidden address in a listed script, fails the build.
